title: Correctness for vector secrets
statement: Let $F$ be a field, let $k>0$, and let $\iota$ be any type. In the vector-valued sharing scheme, for every finite set $A$ of nonzero field elements with at least $k$ members, every secret $v:\iota\to F$, and every randomness function assigning a polynomial of degree less than $k-1$ to each coordinate, reconstruction from the shares of $A$ returns $v$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of nonzero field elements
each randomness value is a polynomial of degree less than $k-1$
